acceptance: repeated bootstrap has no migration race
assumptions: Docker on the development host can reach the registry and the package index for the build; the install proof itself is hash-verified.
The accepted head's frozen lock still describes requirements.txt; the lock is frozen and this grain must not change it.
The image is built and run on linux/amd64, the only platform G0-01 qualified.

context_sources.selection_reason: Development stack whose image references and bootstrap order this grain pins.
Production overlay; carries the other half of the image references.
The image build this grain must make reproducible.
Release tasks (migrate, collectstatic) and their ordering under container start.
The G0 exit this grain contributes to, including the CI obligation.
The frozen artifact set this image must install from instead of requirements.txt.
Normative provenance obligations for image digests and OS package inventory.

decisions: Install the frozen lock into the image with --require-hashes; the direct spaCy artifact is expressed as name @ url#sha256 taken from the artifact inventory.
Pin every image reference (Dockerfile stages, postgres, redis, nginx) to a resolved manifest digest.
Predecessor: SG-000001 at ca5ceb361798ff8ba78a8ac86c47de0bc440058e, accepted head b4531988f4a32143407c5aa2de4d7090d33e4930, receipts sealed at 2d4abc05c4a80e5d9b7a629bac52ed021d8279bb.
Record the OS package inventory of the built image inside the image and in evidence.
Serialise the release tasks so two containers starting together cannot run migrations concurrently.
minimality_evidence: Existing entrypoint structure, compose service graph and healthchecks are preserved; only digests, the install source and the release-task serialisation change.
No new runtime dependency, service or component is added to the stack.
The base image digest chosen for the Dockerfile is the same digest G0-01 resolved and froze against.
workpacket.outcome: Build from G0-01 artifacts, pin image digests, record OS package inventory and run empty-database migrations

risk.recovery: Before effects: revert bounded code/config change and retain old owner. After schema/data/effects: use the recorded expand-contract reverse/forward repair or verified restore, pause outbound dispatch and reconcile remote outcomes. Never infer rollback from Git alone.

scope_in: Build from G0-01 artifacts, pin image digests, record OS package inventory and run empty-database migrations
Only supporting migrations, fixtures, tests, documentation and UI needed for this bounded objective.
scope_out: Changing accepted architecture without a reconciled ADR
Implementing successor tasks or unrelated suites
Unrelated dependency upgrades, formatting or legacy rewrites
